Subject: LPS PPA do not generate billing adjustments
Description: LPS (Park and Loan, TOS LPS-F) PPAs complete the full lifecycle - retro nom error triggers, reallocation records trigger, PPA records trigger, PAN processing moves the PPA to processed, Customer Account Main displays it - but no billing adjustment is generated. Example: TSP 24, contract LPS 1269.2278, gas day 5/31/2026, 114 dth. Workaround: manually compute the daily parking charge and enter an LGA on the contract.
